# SYS-004: Clock is synchronized

- **Group:** System
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

TLS certificate validation, TOTP codes, Kerberos, log correlation and token expiry all depend on correct time. A clock that is not synchronized drifts, and the failures look like unrelated auth and certificate errors.

## Verify by hand

```sh
timedatectl show --property=NTPSynchronized --property=NTP
```

## How to fix it

Enable systemd-timesyncd (`timedatectl set-ntp true`) or install chrony.

## What a fix can break

Stepping the clock can confuse running software that assumes time never jumps.

Run `stackward explain SYS-004` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
